decisions.reason: The Small Block rules are an independent parallel mechanism, and their same-message MODIFY already captures the Small Block trigger and eligible population.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the independent counters, Big Block eligibility window, and post-draw reset required by the source decision.
The existing same-message MODIFY already limits eligible winners to holders of tickets issued since the previous draw for the applicable block.
Changing the Big Block trigger and eligible ticket population does not alter the existing rule that secondary-sale royalties fund the prize pools.
The source explicitly says manual claim remains identical, so the prize-claim workflow does not change.
The existing same-message Event already records that a successful coded referral awards one Small Block ticket and one Big Block ticket.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records visibility of both ticket counters and permanent badges; the Big Block trigger change requires no additional metadata update.
The source states that the random ticket awarded when no referral code is used remains identical, so this Requirement is unchanged.
The statement that secondary royalties continue filling prize pools does not change whether secondary-sale royalties are required or enforced.
